title: Choosing an AI model: the AutoDiag benchmark
keywords: autodiag benchmark bench model models which model choose fast accurate local cloud qwen claude haiku
text: dds-autodiag bench scores AI models on eight fixed Configure RViz scenarios (correct actions, invalid suggestions, time and tokens per plan) without a robot. In the published results, Claude Opus, Sonnet and Haiku 5.5 got every scenario right (Haiku fastest, about 2 s per plan), and the local qwen3:4b-instruct also got every scenario right at about 32 s per plan on a laptop CPU. Run it on your machine with --model provider:model.
